sub_sector.value: Specialty polymers; additives and intermediates; acetate fibers

manufacturing_type.detail: Chemical processing produces specialty copolyesters, polymer interlayers, performance films, additives, chemical intermediates, and cellulose acetate fibers.

product_complexity.detail: Specialty copolyesters, glazing interlayers, and performance films are formulated for specific applications alongside more standardized chemical intermediates.

production_role.detail: Supplies specialty polymers, films, additives, chemical intermediates, and acetate tow for use in customers’ products.

end_market_exposure.detail: Automotive and architectural glazing, consumer goods and tobacco, industrial coatings, medical devices, crop protection, power generation, aviation, and electronics.

notes: Eastman’s mix of make-to-order and make-to-stock production is unclear.
